subject.title: fix(chat): preserve PNG attachments in native clients

question: Should native chat clients replace the established JPEG-normalization policy with PNG preservation, including its larger-payload and fallback tradeoffs?
rationale: The merged Apple implementation explicitly treated JPEG normalization and alpha flattening as intentional transport behavior, while this PR changes that user-visible contract across both native stacks.

options.title: Preserve PNG safely
options.body: Adopt PNG preservation only after the encoder guarantees bounded sendability or applies a clearly defined fallback, with real native-client proof.

options.title: Retain JPEG normalization
options.body: Keep the existing bounded JPEG policy and close or narrow this PR if predictable delivery is more important than transparency preservation.

recommendation.title: Preserve PNG safely
recommendation.body: Adopt PNG preservation only after the encoder guarantees bounded sendability or applies a clearly defined fallback, with real native-client proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The change includes Android picker delivery behavior, and the Android project documentation identifies this handle as the app's ownership contact.
